recent_posts.content_text: Yeah, once the deadline passes anyone can finalize, the campaign lock only checks that the tx’s since is past the deadline block. We run a keeper that finalizes expired campaigns and then releases or refunds the pledges every cycle, and it’s split out so anyone can run their own, psawyerberlin already runs a second one on his node. The gap you’d expect is still there though, a pledge can land between the deadline and the finalize tx, so closing that window is on our list. Makes sense to put the co-signer on chain for L1, otherwise the SDK check is just a suggestion.

recent_posts.author: Code3ks
recent_posts.content_text:
M1 settlement reliability and refund report
Source release: m1-settlement-reliability,
commit aeb88ae
Outcome
M1 makes incoming and outgoing Fiber settlement recoverable across interruption without treating a
timeout as failure, dispatching a second payment, delivering a second credit event, or crediting both
sides of a vendor-settlement/refund race. It also moves the supported direct-settlement pair to Fiber
v0.10.1 and CDK v0.18.3, exposes honest wallet recovery states, and makes failure and redaction
coverage reproducible.
This report distinguishes deterministic CI, opt-in devnet evidence, and public-deployment claims.
Ordinary CI does not contact a Fiber node or perform an economic operation.
Delivered work
Area
Issue
Pull request
Result
Durable settlement journal
#6
#34
Scoped, versioned journal with fail-closed migration and recovery
Incoming recovery
#7
#35
Restored invoice watches and at-most-once credit events
Outgoing recovery
#8
#36
Delayed terminal reconciliation without duplicate dispatch
RPC isolation
#9
#37
Request deadlines, bounded concurrency, backoff, and aggregate metrics
Wallet recovery
#10
#38
Pending/recoverable states and persisted settlement provenance
Vendor refund race
#11
#39
NUT-11 attendee refund with one winning mint swap
Stable compatibility
#12
#33
Fiber v0.10.1 and CDK v0.18.3 migration and devnet evidence
Fault injection and redaction
#13
#40
Failure-class manifest and public-output redaction gates
The wallet now restores mint, unit, network, and asset provenance with affected operations. Payment
reviews separate Cashu proof fees from the Fiber route-fee reserve, while mint availability remains
separate from custody, policy, liquidity, and solvency claims.
The machine-readable settlement evidence manifest
maps 16 deterministic scenarios and seven redaction checks to source selectors and exact
reproduction commands.
Reproduce the release checks
Prerequisites are Git, a rustup-managed Rust 1.88 or newer, Node.js 24, npm, Protocol Buffers,
and an environment supported by Playwright. From a clean checkout of the published tag:
git clone https://github.com/code3ks/fibernuts.git
cd fibernuts
git checkout m1-settlement-reliability
rustup component add rustfmt clippy
npm --prefix wallet ci
npm --prefix relay ci
npm --prefix market ci
npm --prefix wallet exec -- playwright install --with-deps chrome
npm --prefix market exec -- playwright install --with-deps chrome
make ci
The Playwright commands install Chrome and its system dependencies; on Linux they may request
elevated privileges for system packages.
Expected result: the evidence validator, Rust format/lint/test/build checks, wallet tests and browser
checks, relay tests, and market tests and browser checks all exit successfully. The evidence summary
must report 16 deterministic scenarios, all 16 required failure classes, seven redaction checks,
all nine secret classes, all five public sinks, and three separately named opt-in live scenarios.
Actual result on 2026-11-27: passed. make ci exited successfully with all 16 declared failure
classes and all redaction classes covered; 125 Rust tests, 40 wallet unit tests, 21 wallet browser
tests, six relay tests, 35 market unit tests, and 24 market browser tests passed. Three live-devnet
tests remained explicitly ignored by ordinary CI, as required.
The exact tagged commit passed the final
CI run and
Rust CI run on main.
Acceptance scenarios
These commands isolate the four milestone-critical behaviors. Each must exit successfully.
Pending outgoing recovery
cargo test --manifest-path mint/Cargo.toml -p cdk-fiber --test mint_payment a_timed_out_dispatch_is_reconciled_and_never_sent_twice -- --exact
cargo test --manifest-path mint/Cargo.toml -p cdk-fiber --test mint_payment delayed_outgoing_success_is_announced_once_after_restart_with_actual_fee -- --exact
Expected and actual behavior: the durable payment hash is reconciled without another dispatch, and
a delayed success emits once using the original principal plus Fiber’s authoritative actual fee.
Incoming recovery
cargo test --manifest-path mint/Cargo.toml -p cdk-fiber --test mint_payment an_invoice_paid_while_the_processor_is_down_is_restored_on_start -- --exact
Expected and actual behavior: restart restores the invoice/hash binding and emits one credit event
only after Fiber reports Paid.
Isolated RPC timeout
cargo test --manifest-path mint/Cargo.toml -p cdk-fiber --test mint_payment a_stalled_rpc_reaches_its_deadline_without_blocking_other_reconciliation -- --exact
Expected and actual behavior: the stalled request reaches its deadline while another settlement
record continues to reconcile.
Vendor settlement/refund race
npm --prefix market test -- --run src/domain/market-runtime.test.ts -t "allows only one balance credit when refund and vendor settlement race"
Expected and actual behavior: the mint’s first accepted swap is the only balance credit. The losing
path records spent or recoverable state without adding value.
Verification environment
Component
Version used for the M1 verification run
Host
macOS 15.8.1, arm64
Rust
rustc 1.94.1, cargo 1.94.1; workspace minimum 1.88
Node.js
24.13.0
npm
11.6.2
Protocol Buffers
libprotoc 34.1
cargo-audit
0.22.2
Fiber protocol target
v0.10.1, commit d9b6bbd74faf5b168244e3ddea5b6762a04e0a71
CDK protocol target
v0.18.3, commit b2035a3525c98b22226926bdc20fa128a1351ae5
The Fiber/CDK pins, image digests, migration rules, and stable devnet cycle are recorded in the
compatibility matrix.
On 2026-11-22, that disposable three-node devnet passed all three opt-in adapter tests and a
stock-mint cycle that issued 200 units, cashed out 100 units with a one-unit realized fee, and
retained 99 spendable units. That is stable-pair devnet evidence, not public-testnet RUSD, reserve,
solvency, or production-availability evidence.
Security advisory check
The M1 dependency set was checked with:
npm --prefix wallet audit --audit-level=high
npm --prefix market audit --audit-level=high
npm --prefix relay audit --audit-level=high
npm --prefix faucet audit --audit-level=high
cargo audit --file mint/Cargo.lock
cargo audit --file mint/Cargo.lock --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0459
Each npm audit exited successfully and reported zero vulnerabilities. No known critical or
high-severity Rust advisory remains. The unignored Rust audit exits nonzero for one disclosed local
information-disclosure advisory,
RUSTSEC-2026-0459, in bundled SQLite through
rusqlite 0.39.0 and libsqlite3-sys 0.37.0. The second Rust command ignores only that disclosed
advisory and exits successfully while still reporting the unmaintained transitive chrono and
paste warnings.
The SQLite issue requires the processor to open a database and sibling WAL file written by a
less-trusted local party. Operators must keep the journal directory private to the processor and
restore only from trusted operator-controlled backups; journal restore validation rejects corrupt
or incompatible input. Moving to the patched rusqlite 0.41 line requires raising the workspace
minimum from Rust 1.88 to 1.89. That compatibility update remains follow-up dependency work.
Known limitations and unresolved nonblocking work
CDK 0.18.3 does not acknowledge a payment-event stream item after the mint database commits it.
Pull status checks remain the authoritative idempotent recovery path.
Background incoming polling is bounded by the configured grace period. The durable record remains
available for an explicit status check and is never converted to failure by elapsed time.
Fiber may report a paid historical payment without a preimage. Paid state remains authoritative;
a missing optional payment proof is not failure.
Browser proofs and operation recovery use local browser storage. This is neither a secure vault
nor a guaranteed backup, and multi-tab compare-and-swap remains future hardening.
The stable live cycle used a local dev UDT. It does not establish that the public reference
deployment has migrated, is solvent, or has sufficient directional RUSD liquidity.
FiberNuts has not received a formal third-party security audit and is not presented as a
production mint endorsement.
The disclosed SQLite advisory and the two unmaintained transitive crates remain nonblocking
dependency work; none is represented as resolved by the M1 tag.
Hosted-LSP onboarding, browser-funded channels, reusable package publication, and controlled
mainnet validation belong to later milestones.
Incidents and findings
No known user-value loss occurred during M1, and no mainnet value was used. Implementation findings
resolved during M1 included repeat-dispatch and migration hardening, wallet dependency updates,
credential-bearing mint URL rejection, diagnostic identity redaction, and stronger evidence-command
and screenshot-surface validation. No fixture or mocked result is reported as a live Fiber
settlement.
What comes next
M2 focuses on public-testnet hosted-LSP onboarding. A user will connect a supported CKB wallet,
review and approve the required RUSD funding and CKB capacity, and reach a usable hosted Fiber
channel without operating a local FNN node. The work includes client signing, exact funding and fee
review, durable channel lifecycle recovery, hosted add-cash and cash-out flows, and failure and
interoperability testing.

recent_posts.content_text:
上贴发的有些匆忙，中间有几处错误（已修改）。也感谢 @zz_tovarishch 的解释。
这个游戏我只进入页面，但并没有去试玩（因为我不是游戏爱好者）。我也并不清楚项目情况。
只是看到社区资助项目多数在工具端，建议可以适当关注下应用类项目，尤其是社区自行完成的优质项目，可以用可行的间接方式的帮其度下冷启动期。
当然应用类项目必须要有自己的盈利模式，而不是去依赖社区的资助存活。资助模式更希望是以赞助/提供流动性等方面的参与，并不是对还未成型的应用方案文档来资助。

topics.title: Discussion: Improving the Fairness and Resilience of CKB Community Fund DAO Governance |关于 CKB Community Fund DAO 治理机制的一些思考与改进建议

recent_posts.topic_title: Discussion: Improving the Fairness and Resilience of CKB Community Fund DAO Governance |关于 CKB Community Fund DAO 治理机制的一些思考与改进建议
recent_posts.author: JackyLHH
recent_posts.content_text:
谢谢 @yixiu.ckbfans.bit 发起这个讨论，我个人非常认可你提到的不太担心第一阶段的点赞数量，更希望看到有更多社区成员参与讨论。
关于第二阶段的投票，我还是赞成把 Nervos DAO 的存款时长纳入计票。每笔存款单独算，时间系数可以设为 1～3 倍。存款不超过 12 个月，按 1 倍算。之后每多存满 1 个月，系数加 0.1，存满 32 个月就达到 3 倍上限。
我个人还有两个建议：
给持续参与投票的账户加成。 参与系数从 1.00 起算，账户每在 Metaforo 上对一项 CKB Community Fund DAO 提案投过有效票，系数就加 0.05（上限为 1，即超过 20 次投票后权重不再增加）。同一项提案只记一次。比如，A 和 B 都在 Nervos DAO 存了 10 万 CKB，其他条件也一样。A 第一次投票，参与系数是 1.00。B 第 5 次投票，之前的 4 次各加了 0.05，所以此次投票的参与系数就是 1.20。给每次参与一点小小的积累，希望能让更多社区成员愿意投出自己的一票。
CKBA 贡献会员的投票权重再乘以 1.5。 CKBA 常年开放贡献会员申请，申请经审核后，由 GA 大会投票决定是否接纳。这项加成既是对他们贡献的肯定，也是鼓励他们继续积极参与 Nervos 生态。
附：截止到今天，一共有 16 位贡献会员：
iShot_2026-11-27_10.03.241966×352 32.7 KB
举个例子，一位 CKBA 贡献会员在 Nervos DAO 存了 10 万 CKB，已经存满 18 个月，这次是他/她第 6 次投票。把三项系数乘起来，投票权重相当于 30 万 CKB。
10 万 CKB × 1.6（时间系数）× 1.25（参与系数）× 1.5（贡献会员）＝ 30 万 CKB 等值票权
这些参数只是方便举例，具体怎么定，还是要大家一起深入讨论。 计时也可以改用链上的 Epoch，180 个 Epoch 大约是 30 天。比如，存满 2,160 个 Epoch（约一年）后，每再存满 180 个 Epoch，时间系数就加 0.1，到 5,760 个 Epoch 达到 3 倍上限。
最后建议开发一个新的投票平台来替代 Metaforo。新平台可以集成 CCC，接入更多钱包，并自动验证对应的 Nervos DAO 存款。这样，更多用户就能直接用自己熟悉的钱包投票。

10 万 CKB × 1.6（时间系数）× 1.25（参与系数）× 1.5（贡献会员）＝ 30 万 CKB 等值票权

最后建议开发一个新的投票平台来替代 Metaforo。新平台可以集成 CCC，接入更多钱包，并自动验证对应的 Nervos DAO 存款。这样，更多用户就能直接用自己熟悉的钱包投票。

recent_posts.topic_title: Discussion: Improving the Fairness and Resilience of CKB Community Fund DAO Governance |关于 CKB Community Fund DAO 治理机制的一些思考与改进建议
recent_posts.author: CDEX
recent_posts.content_text:
I don’t like this idea.
It feels like some proposals have been blocked by whales, and because we really want them to pass, we are now considering changing the rules to dilute the influence of whales.
We should be lowering the barriers to governance participation and enabling more wallets in, rather than raising those barriers and giving long-standing participants disproportionately greater influence.
I believe we should focus on making CKB more attractive so that more people are willing to acquire CKB specifically for participation, rather than pushing proposals through to create an artificial sense of community activity.
This would better align the incentives of proposal authors and voters, instead of putting them in opposition to each other.
To me, this idea seems to favor those who are unwilling to acquire CKB, but not encourage more people to become economically invested in the ecosystem.

recent_posts.author: JackyLHH
recent_posts.content_text:
CDEX:
We should make governance more accessible, not make voting power cheaper
I love this input.
Looking back, the multipliers I suggested were too aggressive. Together, they could give someone up to 9× their base voting power. A 2× cap on the combined multiplier seems like a more reasonable starting point if we decide to revisit the formula.
Changing the CKB Community Fund DAO’s meta-rules is difficult and takes time, and should be done step by step. Supporting more wallets (including CCC) is a good first step. From there, we could explore building a more user-friendly alternative to Metaforo. Once we’ve made it easier to participate, we can revisit how voting power is calculated and even discuss whether to add vote delegation.

recent_posts.content_text:
十分同意“用金钱投票是短视的”。比特币用工作量证明通过数学方式解决信任问题，Dao治理的难点是怎么制造信任，去中心化治理需要从公共基金中提取资金，天然存在很强的博弈性，加之信息不透明，很容易出现现在很多人对Dao提案人不信任的情况。
我不懂博弈论，不知道有没有大神能从博弈论的角度来缓解信任问题呢。我这边有一些可能不完善的想法: 1引入Ai工具对提案人的profile进行初步审查，并提供初步的评级，使得社区成员可以很便捷的进行初步的评估。2引入一个咨询委员会，协助进行评估。3现在只有提案阶段的治理，引入结案阶段的治理方案。4不知道之前Dao那个声誉系统是否可以集成。

recent_posts.author: yixiu.ckbfans.bit
recent_posts.content_text:
Hi, Enzo, CellCat 是一个蛮有意思的项目，我认为它完全有可能走向我们的社区用户。不过我们留意到你在CellCat里自己做了cat-type, egg-type，不知你能否考虑使用现有的spore协议来实现，原因是生态里目前对nft的适配方面，对spore的支持是最好的。若新开发一套nft type标准，会带来较多的适配工作，比如钱包、ccc、交易市场、资产管理器、浏览器等都需要做一遍兼容性适配，这会带来一些挑战。
另外， 你的开发计划里提到 接通 JoyID（Testnet）。是否有考虑直接接 @ckb-ccc/connector-react （以下简称ccc），通过几行代码，就可以对接上生态里支持的所有钱包，你只需要关注自己的业务即可。 我们也为ccc专门做了一套用于AI 访问和使用ccc相关模块的skills，详情在这里：配置你的 AI 工具 。
